cells.reason: These passages state Raymond James' affiliation models (AdvisorChoice®) and a change it made to its employee model (book ownership), which is what the sub-question asks about.

items.text: Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options under the AdvisorChoice® platform: Traditional Employee, Advisor Select, Independent Contractor, Bank & Credit Union, Corporate RIA, and RIA & Custody Services.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you... Traditional Employee... Advisor Select... Independent Contractor... Bank & Credit Union... Corporate RIA... RIA & Custody Services

items.text: Raymond James states it has redefined the employee advisor experience by enabling advisor book ownership.
items.quote: True partnership. We've redefined the employee advisor experience, enabled by advisor book ownership. It's your business. Your brand. Your clients.

items.text: Raymond James describes its affiliation options as AdvisorChoice®, with advisors affiliating as employees, independent contractors, or as employees of third-party RIAs and broker-dealers served through its RIA and Custody Services division.
items.quote: We offer multiple affiliation options, which we refer to as AdvisorChoice®. Financial advisors primarily affiliate with us directly as either employees or independent contractors or as employees of third-party Registered Investment Advisors ("RIAs") and broker-dealers to which we provide services through our RIA and Custody Services ("RCS") division.

items.text: Raymond James describes its Advisor Select® affiliation model as an employee affiliation option for advisors who want to lead their own branch and run the branch's P&L.
items.quote: Advisor Select® provides established advisors the full benefits of our employee channel with the independence to create their own branches... That's Advisor Select®, an employee affiliation option for advisors who want to lead a team... Choose a location, build out your office and run your branch's P&L to earn a higher rate on production.

items.text: Raymond James states its independent contractor financial advisors may affiliate directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in its Financial Institutions Division.
items.quote: Independent contractor financial advisors may affiliate with us directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in our Financial Institutions Division.

items.text: Raymond James lists the payouts, qualifications, and compliance arrangements for each affiliation model, including Traditional Employee, Advisor Select, Independent Contractor, Bank & Credit Union, Corporate RIA, and RIA & Custody Services.
items.quote: Model: Traditional Employee... Up to 50% payout**... Model: Advisor Select... 70-80% gross payout**... Model: Independent Contractor... 81% to 90% payout***... Model: Corporate RIA... 81% to 90% payout***... Model: RIA & Custody Services
